title: Risk tier mapping & escalation playbook
content:
Purpose:
This doc defines a practical, ops-friendly mapping from composite health signals into discrete risk tiers and prescribes escalation steps and owner responsibilities. Intended for CSMs, AMs, and CS managers to standardize near-term renewal actions and reduce variability across accounts.

Status / approach notes (quick):
- Draft: run with this for Q3 pilot across 10 accounts (mix of SMB, mid-market).
- We expect thresholds to change after two weeks of live scoring and at least three post-mortem renewals reviewed.
- Focus on signal clarity and low-friction actions vs perfect models.

High-level summary:
- Input signals: product usage (DAU, feature-adoption), error/incident rate, billing health, support/CSAT signals, engagement cadence, ROI signals (e.g., jobs completed, API keys active), and contractual timelines.
- Score composite (0-100) with simple weighted sum (weights below).
- Map composite to 4 risk tiers: Green (>=75), Yellow (50-74), Orange (30-49), Red (<30).
- Each tier has prescribed cadence, owner, and playbook steps.
- Automations: Slack alerts for Orange->Red moves, calendar auto-create for Yellow accounts crossing renewal window.

Signal definition and suggested weights (pilot):
- Feature adoption (new major features used in last 30d): weight 25
- Active seats / usage growth (30d delta): weight 20
- Error rate / incidents per 1k requests (normalized): weight 15 (negatively correlated)
- Support volume + sentiment (last 90d): weight 15 (negatively correlated)
- Engagement (meetings, collateral opened, support cases responded): weight 10
- Billing status & entitlements (late invoices, PO issues): weight 10 (negatively correlated)
- Product ROI indicator (custom metric: e.g., cost saved or query success): weight 5

Scoring notes:
- Normalize each input to 0-100 before applying weight. E.g., feature adoption: percent of targeted feature cohort that used feature (0-100). Error rate transform: score = max(0, 100 - (error_rate_norm * 200)) so small error spikes reduce score gradually.
- Missing data fallback: if a signal is missing, scale remaining weights proportionally. Prefer conservative default (assume neutral 50 rather than optimistically 75).

Risk tier thresholds (pilot):
- Green 75-100: Healthy. Low-touch cadence. Continue standard renewal outreach 90/60/30 days before renewal.
- Yellow 50-74: Watch. Proactive enablement + health check. 30-day plan to prevent drift; AM to run adoption mini-audit.
- Orange 30-49: At-risk. 14-day intervention plan; CSM + Solutions Engineer (SE) pairing; escalate to CSM manager if no improvement in 21 days.
- Red 0-29: High-risk. Immediate executive alert, commercial/ops involvement, remedial contract actions or technical deep-dive within 5 business days. Consider retention ops (discounts, proof-of-value, dedicated SE hours).

Escalation matrix (owner & steps):
- Green:
  - Owner: AM/CSM
  - Actions: Quarterly business review prep, standard renewal emails 90/60/30, no extra resources allocated.

- Yellow:
  - Owner: CSM primary, AM secondary
  - Trigger: Composite crosses into Yellow OR single major signal drop (feature adoption down >30% MoM)
  - Actions (14 day):
    1) 1:1 health check call with CSM; share short adoption checklist
    2) Send enablement playbook & product tips tailored to gap signals
    3) Create 30-day adoption plan with 3 milestones and measurable success criteria
    4) Log P0 in CRM and tag account with "yellow-action"

- Orange:
  - Owner: CSM + Solutions Engineer
  - Trigger: Sustained Yellow for 21 days or sudden multi-signal drop
  - Actions (14 day intensive):
    1) Immediate SE triage for any technical blockers (SLA: 3 business days for triage session)
    2) Set up weekly status calls; CSM to run progress tracker in shared sheet
    3) Offer targeted enablement session (recorded + custom docs)
    4) If billing issues present, loop Finance Ops and place renewal hold flag in CRM with reason
    5) Escalate to CSM Manager if no improvement after 21 days

- Red:
  - Owner: CSM Manager + Head of Renewals (and assigned Exec sponsor)
  - Trigger: Composite <30 OR legal/billing+product failure combo OR executive churn signal
  - Actions (immediate):
    1) Exec alert email with one-pager summarizing signals, timeline, and ask (within 24 hours)
    2) On-site or dedicated technical deep-dive within 5 business days (remote ok)
    3) Commercial options: short-term discount, extended PO window, or pilot for high-value feature (document as commercial exception)
    4) Create retention plan with daily tracking until improvement; weekly review with Head of Renewals
    5) Prepare final decision memo 7 days before renewal cut-off

Operational playbook templates (copy into CRM / shared drive):
- Yellow email template (short): 
  Subject: Quick health check + 30-day plan for <AccountName>
  Body: Hi <Name>, spotted some early signs of low adoption — can we do a 30-minute sync to review a 3-step plan? (link to calendar)

- Orange playbook checklist (CSM to complete):
  - [ ] SE triage scheduled (date)
  - [ ] 1st weekly status call recorded
  - [ ] Adoption milestones created in shared doc
  - [ ] Billing/contract issues logged and assigned

- Red exec alert template (email + one-pager):
  - Subject: URGENT: <Account> at high renewal risk (Action requested)
  - Attach: one-pager (signals, timeline, recommended commercial options)

Measurement and KPIs (for the pilot):
- Primary: renewal outcome within 90 days of tier assignment (binary).
- Secondary: delta in composite score after 14 and 30 days; number of accounts recovered from Orange/Red to Green; time-to-first-action after tier change.
- Process KPI: percent of tier moves that generated automation records (slack/calendar/CRM link).

Implementation notes (engineering & ops):
- Data feed cadence: daily aggregated signals preferred. For the pilot, nightly batch OK.
- CRM: map tier to custom field cs_risk_tier and add automated activity creation for Yellow->30day-check, Orange->SE-triage, Red->exec-alert.
- Automation: use Slack channel #cs-alerts for Orange/Red with account, score, quick link to CRM record and shared sheet.
- Data ownership: Product Analytics provides usage/feature signals; Support provides volume/sentiment; Billing provides status.

Sample quick scoring worksheet (CSV-like lines; copy into sheet):
account_id,account_name,feature_adoption_pct,usage_growth_pct,error_rate_norm,support_sentiment,billing_flag,roi_score,composite_score,tier
1234,AcmeCo,78,5,0.02,80,0,60,80,Green
2345,BlueInc,40,-12,0.15,45,1,30,41,Orange

Open questions / TODOs (stickies):
- Which exact signals should override composite automatically? (e.g., legal escalation or security incident should force Red).
- Agree on default weight adjustments if any signal source is missing >3 days.
- Confirm CRM custom field names with Ops (ticket: JIRA CS-4321).
- Need standard naming convention for generated docs and sheets (suggest: risk-<tier>-<acct>-YYYYMMDD).

Notes to self / CSM tips:
- Keep interventions short and measurable. Avoid long multi-step asks that require heavy customer time up-front.
- For mid-market accounts, prioritize SE hours vs discounts. For SMB, prefer low-friction enablement + clear ROI examples.
- Document wins and failed plays — we will revise weights after 10 pilot accounts closed.

Appendix (links to sample templates):
- Shared sheet (pilot tracker): renewal-timing-sim-v1
- Email templates: /templates/cs/email-templates/

End of draft.

(Quick log) 2025-07-15: Ran through with Priya and Connor — agreed to pilot 10 accounts (mix) starting 2025-07-22. Next update due 2025-08-12 after first two-week review.
